confirmedRequirements: Object-form cueVideoById/loadVideoById support absolute start/end seconds; seekTo invalidates a previous end bound.
Player viewport minimum is 200 by 200; official recommendation is 480 by 270 when feasible; usable controls also matter.
HTTP Referer or equivalent client identification is required; strict-origin-when-cross-origin is recommended.
cc_load_policy=1 requests captions even when the user previously disabled them; default preference must omit forcing.
Made for Kids designation must be checked for each embedded video; child-directed videos require appropriate data/tracking handling.
Official controls, links, branding and advertising must remain unobscured; no background player or media/transcript extraction.
